modules.name: io.github.linoleic.multiroute
modules.summary:
分应用路由、副 Wi-Fi 管理与个人热点上游选择。
Per-app routing, secondary Wi-Fi management, and hotspot upstream selection.

releases.name: MultiRoute 1.6.0
releases.descriptionHTML:
v1.6.0 - 2026-10-31

中文

新增

  • 副卡数据通道入口：在网络通道页启用、停用非默认数据卡通道，区分激活进程和网络实际状态，并提供请求与兼容两种方式。卡片沿用网络通道图标样式，摘要显示 SIM、副卡启用状态和当前操作；网络验证状态、SIM 详情、完整说明与激活方式可展开查看，滚动离屏后保留状态与展开设置。
  • 按 SIM 保存分流目标：可识别的 SIM 使用设备内稳定标识，网络重建后重新解析到当前接口；身份无法匹配时提示重新选择，保留旧接口规则兼容。
  • 配置备份 v3：保存 SIM 分流与场景目标，继续读取 v1/v2 备份；跨设备导入时提示无法匹配的 SIM。

修复

  • 双 Wi-Fi 界面排版：激活状态移至硬件支持卡片右下角；附近网络的频段、推荐/冲突和已保存标签可自适应换行，长 SSID 与连接按钮不再挤压标签。
  • 双 Wi-Fi 英文显示：补齐连接、诊断、状态、冲突、频段和信号等界面与运行时提示的英文文案。
  • 双 Wi-Fi 控制与支持详情：可完整停用并发模式、停止应用自动重连，保留已保存网络和原自动重连偏好；停用后刷新附近网络状态，避免断开的网络仍显示为副 Wi-Fi。热点仍使用副 Wi-Fi 时阻止停用。连接方式选择收纳在支持详情的“系统定制环境与方案”项中；支持状态默认简要显示，诊断状态标签位于对应说明下方。
  • 多蜂窝网络分流：系统默认网络与 DNS 使用当前生效的场景及在线通道配置；切换目标通道或同一接口的网络重建后刷新对应应用的网络选择。
  • 蜂窝 IPv6 回退：目标通道丢失 IPv6 路由时阻止流量静默转入另一张 SIM，恢复路由后可继续使用原通道。
  • 副卡通道停用：正常停用时先释放网络请求并恢复修改前的双卡状态，再退出后台进程。

English

Added

  • Secondary cellular controls: Enable or stop the non-default data SIM channel from the channels tab, distinguish process state from network availability, and choose request or compatibility mode. Reuse the network-card icon style; show the SIM, enabled state and current action in the summary; expand for network validation, SIM details and full notes. Preserve state and expanded settings after scrolling offscreen.
  • SIM routing targets: Use device-scoped identities for identifiable SIMs and resolve the current interface after network recreation. Prompt for reselection when identity cannot be matched; retain legacy interface assignments.
  • Configuration backup v3: Preserve SIM assignments and scenario targets while reading v1/v2 backups. Report unmatched SIMs when importing on another device.

Fixed

  • Dual Wi-Fi layout: Move readiness status to the bottom-right of the capability card. Let nearby-network band, recommendation/conflict and saved labels wrap; constrain long SSIDs and action labels so they do not crowd the tags.
  • Dual Wi-Fi English: Complete English text for connection, diagnostics, status, conflicts, bands, signal and runtime messages.
  • Dual Wi-Fi controls and support details: Add a full shutdown for concurrency mode and app auto-reconnect while keeping the saved network and auto-reconnect preference. Refresh nearby network state after shutdown so a disconnected network is no longer labeled as secondary Wi-Fi. Block shutdown while the hotspot still uses secondary Wi-Fi. Place connection method choices under System Environment and Scheme in support details; keep the summary compact by default and place diagnostic status tags below their descriptions.
  • Multiple cellular networks: Use effective scenario and online-channel assignments for per-app default networks and DNS. Refresh selection when the target changes or its Network instance is replaced on the same interface.
  • Cellular IPv6 fallback: Prevent traffic from silently using another SIM when the selected channel loses its IPv6 route. Resume using the selected channel when its route returns.
  • Secondary cellular shutdown: Release network requests and restore the previous dual-SIM state before the background process exits during normal shutdown.

releases.name: MultiRoute 1.5.0
releases.descriptionHTML:
v1.5.0 - 2026-10-27

中文

新增

  • 个人热点出口选择：可选择蜂窝网络、副 Wi-Fi 或系统默认网络作为热点上游；新增控制卡片，展示热点频段、实际出口和模块状态，并支持提前设置出口。
  • 热点通道识别：展示热点下行接口及其属性，并从应用分流和场景目标中排除这些接口。
  • VPN 通道详情：展示 VPN 创建应用、隧道 IP 和底层承载网络。

变更

  • 配置备份 v2：支持导入预览和按类别恢复，覆盖应用分流、场景选择、网络策略、热点出口、双 Wi-Fi 偏好、外观和测速节点，兼容 v1 文件。
  • LSPosed 作用域：除系统框架外，热点出口功能还需启用设备对应的 NetworkStack / Tethering 作用域。
  • 双 Wi-Fi 状态概览：主界面直接展示主、副 Wi-Fi 的网络名称与频段。
  • VPN 分流目标：VPN 保留为可选目标；分应用选择器限制 VPN 所属应用及部分常见 VPN 客户端选择 VPN 通道，减少路由冲突。

修复

  • 双 Wi-Fi 连接与断开：修复取消或断开后仍自动连回、重复重连和旧通知干扰新连接的问题；连接失败或取消后清理未完成的副网连接。
  • 小米副 Wi-Fi 重连：修复重复请求导致连续断开、重连失败的问题。
  • 双 Wi-Fi 服务稳定性：修复断开连接后偶发的前台服务超时崩溃。
  • 保存网络保护：日常连接与断开不再删除系统保存网络；AOSP 方案只释放本模块登记的连接请求。
  • AOSP 连接入口：已保存的加密网络无需在应用内提供密码；未保存网络可直接打开系统 Wi-Fi 设置。修复手动连接方案被覆盖和旧密码弹窗残留的问题。
  • 双 Wi-Fi 状态显示：连接、断开后的诊断信息及时反映当前链路状态。
  • 配置导出与恢复：导出不包含副 Wi-Fi 密码；完整恢复手动模式和所选场景。清空分流或分类导入保留其他设置；备份失败时停止导入，写入失败时尝试恢复原配置并报告错误。
  • 开机规则恢复：修复所有目标通道离线时修改或导入规则，导致下次启动仍恢复旧配置的问题。
  • 热点出口切换与回退：修复蜂窝出口误选、目标网络恢复后未重新选择，以及停止共享后未恢复原配置的问题。
  • Pixel 兼容性：修复部分 Pixel / Google 网络组件下的网络选择和热点出口兼容问题。
  • 热点状态与响应：修复模块加载状态误报、实际出口显示滞后及操作卡顿；设置失败时显示读取到的实际值。
  • 界面显示：修复浅色主题状态栏图标对比不足、VPN 详情占位符和深色卡片边框问题，改善长网络名称的显示。

English

Added

  • Hotspot upstream selection: Choose Cellular, Secondary Wi-Fi or System Default. A new card displays the hotspot band, actual upstream and module status, and supports choosing an upstream before starting the hotspot.
  • Hotspot channel recognition: Display hotspot downlinks and their properties, and exclude them from app routing and scenario targets.
  • VPN channel details: Display the VPN creator app, tunnel IP and underlying networks.

Changed

  • Configuration backup v2: Preview imports and restore selected categories covering app routing, scenario selections, network policies, hotspot upstream, dual Wi-Fi preferences, appearance and test endpoints. Existing v1 files remain supported.
  • LSPosed scope: Hotspot upstream selection also requires the NetworkStack / Tethering scopes available on the device, alongside the system framework.
  • Dual Wi-Fi overview: Show the primary and secondary network names and bands on the main screen.
  • VPN routing targets: VPN networks remain selectable. App assignment pickers restrict VPN owner apps and some recognized VPN clients from selecting VPN channels to reduce routing conflicts.

Fixed

  • Dual Wi-Fi connection and disconnection: Fix unwanted reconnection after cancellation or disconnect, overlapping retries and old notifications affecting new connections. Clean up unfinished secondary connections after failure or cancellation.
  • Xiaomi secondary Wi-Fi reconnection: Fix duplicate requests causing repeated disconnects or failed reconnections.
  • Dual Wi-Fi service stability: Fix an occasional foreground-service timeout crash after disconnecting.
  • Saved network protection: Preserve system-saved networks during normal connections and disconnections. The AOSP scheme releases only connection requests recorded by this module.
  • AOSP connection entry: Connect to saved encrypted networks without an in-app password and open system Wi-Fi settings for unsaved networks. Honor manually selected schemes and clear obsolete password dialogs.
  • Dual Wi-Fi status: Keep diagnostics consistent with the current connection state after connecting or disconnecting.
  • Configuration export and restore: Omit secondary Wi-Fi passwords from exports and restore manual mode and all selected plans. Preserve other settings when clearing routing or importing selected categories. Abort import if backup fails; attempt to restore the original configuration and report write failures.
  • Boot rule recovery: Fix stale configuration being restored at the next boot after editing or importing rules while all target channels are offline.
  • Hotspot switching and fallback: Fix incorrect cellular selection, missing reselection when a target returns and failure to restore the original configuration when sharing stops.
  • Pixel compatibility: Fix network selection and hotspot upstream compatibility with some Pixel / Google network components.
  • Hotspot status and responsiveness: Fix incorrect module status, stale upstream labels and unresponsive controls. Show the actual setting when an update fails.
  • UI display: Fix low-contrast status bar icons in light mode, VPN detail placeholders and dark card borders. Improve long network-name display.

releases.name: MultiRoute 1.4.1
releases.descriptionHTML:
v1.4.1

中文

  • 热点与双 Wi-Fi 射频互斥与联动：
    • 支持检测本机个人热点（SoftAP）状态与频段，避免副 Wi-Fi 与热点占用相同射频产生冲突。
    • 热点关闭后，若开启了自动重连，会自动尝试恢复连接副 Wi-Fi。
  • 小米 / HyperOS 双 Wi-Fi 连接优化：
    • 优化小米/HyperOS 机型连接副 Wi-Fi 的逻辑，协同系统 SlaveWifiService，避免发起连接时占用主 Wi-Fi 通道导致主连接断开或连接超时。
    • 修复小米设备上部分 Wi-Fi 扫描结果信号强度显示为 -99 dBm 的问题。
  • 主副 Wi-Fi 防冲突与断开逻辑完善：
    • 限制不能将当前已连的主 Wi-Fi 作为副 Wi-Fi 连接。
    • 优化副 Wi-Fi 断开流程，清理残留的网络请求与配置，避免偶发自动重连。
  • UI 与细节调整：
    • 优化主界面 Wi-Fi 信号图标显示效果。
    • 修复热点提示卡片在深色模式下的边框颜色显示问题。

English

  • Personal Hotspot Compatibility:
    • Detect active SoftAP hotspot state and frequency band to avoid concurrent radio conflicts on the secondary Wi-Fi.
    • Automatically reconnect secondary Wi-Fi after Hotspot is turned off (when auto-reconnect is enabled).
  • Xiaomi / HyperOS Compatibility:
    • Improve secondary Wi-Fi connection flow on Xiaomi/HyperOS via SlaveWifiService, preventing primary Wi-Fi disconnections and connection timeouts.
    • Fix an issue where some Wi-Fi scan results showed -99 dBm on Xiaomi devices.
  • Connection & Teardown Improvements:
    • Prevent connecting to the active primary Wi-Fi as secondary Wi-Fi.
    • Clean up residual requests and configurations when disconnecting secondary Wi-Fi to prevent unintended auto-reconnection.
  • UI Adjustments:
    • Refine main screen Wi-Fi signal icon style.
    • Fix card border color in dark theme when hotspot is active.

modules.name: com.lixingchi.appclone
modules.summary: Material You clone manager for Android 13+: every instance inline, profile renaming, shortcuts and per-instance controls, with raised AOSP profile limits.

releases.descriptionHTML:
App Clone 2.2.0

  • Redesigned Material 3 lists show every profile directly beneath its app,
    with Open and a per-instance ⋮ menu instead of Manage.
  • Swipeable Apps / Profiles tabs keep independent search and scroll positions,
    including after rotation. Long lists recycle rows; search/status scroll with content.
  • Rename profile saves the exact name without changing IDs, app data or running
    state. It affects all apps sharing that profile; existing shortcut labels stay unchanged.
  • Root-shell startup retries the canonical Android su path only when PATH lookup
    cannot find the executable; started/denied/timed-out operations are never replayed.
    Diagnostics now include app UID/PATH and a root identity check.
  • Raises AOSP clone-profile limits so many clone users can run at once.
  • App-first Apps / Profiles navigation: only cloned apps, with counts
    and profile locations; disabled apps and stopped profiles stay visible.
  • Navigation reuses inventory instead of rescanning. Refresh picks up external
    changes, keeps visible rows/scroll and combines repeated requests; errors offer Retry.
  • Material You / Material 3 Expressive 1.14.0, dynamic colours and dark mode.
  • Explicit existing/new profile choices when adding clones; no automatic allocation.
  • Per-clone Disable/Enable, manifest default, Force stop, shortcuts and removal.
    Disabling pauses that app's notifications; removal deletes its profile-local data.
  • Background activity previews a clone package's Android background mode:
    Keep current, Restrict, or Restore previous. Restrictions can delay notifications/jobs;
    they do not stop profiles or disable apps. Prior modes are saved before mutation.
  • Open/shortcuts combine fresh identity/package/readiness checks and launch in one
    bounded root process; already-unlocked profiles skip startup/authentication.
  • System apps are hidden initially; the visible menu filter can include them.
  • Starts or stops individual profiles without deleting their app data.
  • Home-screen shortcuts and Open start stopped profiles and request Android's
    cached shared-credential unlock before launching. If authentication is needed,
    the error explains how to unlock with the main user's PIN/pattern/password.
  • Choose System default, Start all profiles, or Stop all profiles
    once after reboot and main-user unlock; stopping pauses notifications.
  • Pin shortcuts from the selected instance; new shortcuts bind the profile serial.
  • Export diagnostics includes the failed creation command, users and filtered logcat.
  • Labels shortcuts such as 12: Chrome.
  • Keeps app data separate per clone user.

Requirements: Android 13+ and an Xposed framework that supports the
legacy Xposed API 82 (LSPosed or Vector). Scope the module to
system (android). Device-tested on Pixel 11 Pro Fold, Android 17;
Android 13–16 use the same AOSP clone type but are not yet tested.
The UI/app controls pass host checks; 2.2 UI/rename and 2.1 launch/background-policy device acceptance,
battery effects and notification delivery are unmeasured. No automatic cleaning or
Google-service changes. Restore background settings before clearing App Clone's data.

modules.name: io.github.benbaobaoshigemi.fkoscreen
modules.summary: ColorOS 屏幕显示与画质增强

releases.descriptionHTML: 移除全局 HDR 亮度比例锁定，显示内容使用系统当前 HDR 余量。

初版正式发布：

  • 屏幕亮度与 HDR 增强：高亮激发模式 (HBM) 手动提升、阻止 FOSS 自动降亮、修复 HDR 亮度比例锁定为 1.56
  • 屏幕色彩正交双滑块：色温冷暖与青品偏色数学正交独立调节，RGB 输出增益矩阵双向无缝防抖同步
  • 色彩与深色模式进阶：原生深色模式三档切换支持、色温球作为自适应基底解耦
  • 试验性极限功能：解锁硬件极限峰值亮度、解除系统底层温度对亮度限制
  • 纯正 MIUIX 原生风格设计：100% 严格基于官方 top.yukonga.miuix.kmp 组件库构建

更新内容：

  • 新增「AOD 亮度」滑块（×0.50～×1.00，默认原生 ×0.625），用于调节全景 AOD 的亮度系数；环境光不足 25 lux 的夜间档位保持不变
  • 修复模块界面的开关无法写入系统设置、导致 hook 读不到配置的问题
  • 开关改为通过 Settings.System 传递给被 hook 的进程
  • 源码级 144Hz 支持，补全温控绕过的遗漏路径

modules.name: com.haostoo.wetypehookr
modules.summary: 豆包微信震动棒

releases.descriptionHTML:
• 新增讯飞输入法，Gboard支持

  • 设置页现在通过输入法设置的FAB打开

  • 小修小补

  • 部分ROM对输入法的震动反馈有特调震动，例如对于作者的设备微信输入法和gboard都在此白名单中，导致输入法发出的震动不能被原样播放。该问题本模块目前无法通过操作模块与宿主绕过。因此如果在您的设备上也出现了部分输入法有两段震动但震动降级/与配置不一致请考虑此限制。未来可能通过Hook系统框架解决，免root框架暂时无解决方案。

releases.name: ver1.2.2
releases.descriptionHTML:
v1.2.2 (1225) · 2026-08-29

  • 修复：设置页与 hook 的配置路径不一致问题，配置读写统一指向宿主（输入法）目录，修改设置能正确生效
  • 新增：配置热重载（FileObserver 监听配置目录），保存后即时生效，无需重启输入法
  • 新增：外观主题（浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统）
  • 新增：调试与日志 —— 调试输出开关（按分类输出 hardware/vibrate/ui 日志到 logs 目录）、清除日志、导出日志（打包 zip 到指定位置）

releases.name: FocusPen Pro X 0.11.0
releases.descriptionHTML:
简体中文

  • 支持 HyperOS 3 / HyperOS 4 适配路径，可自动识别或在“其他设置”手动切换。
  • 白名单和黑名单新增“显示所有应用”，可列出没有桌面图标的已安装应用；状态会跨名单与应用重启保留。

English

  • Added HyperOS 3 and HyperOS 4 adapter paths, with automatic detection and manual selection in Other settings.
  • Added “Show all apps” to both allowlist and blacklist, including installed apps without launcher icons. The selection persists across lists and app restarts.
  • Selecting an updated system app automatically expands the list; factory-preinstalled apps do not trigger auto-expansion. Tap “Launchers” to collapse it manually.
  • Verified on Xiaomi Pad 8 Pro: HyperOS 3 OS3.0.307.0.WOCCNXM / Android 16 and HyperOS 4 OS4.0.4.0.XPYCNXM / Android 17.

  • 更新设备兼容说明；其他设备及系统版本仍需单独验证。

English

  • Added HyperOS 3, HyperOS 4, and automatic adapter selection.
  • HyperOS 4 support was confirmed working by the user on Xiaomi Pad 8 Pro (OS4.0.4.0.XPYCNXM, Android 17).
  • Updated compatibility documentation; other devices and builds still require separate validation.

releases.name: FocusPen Pro X 0.9.0
releases.descriptionHTML:
中文

新增

  • 小米原版激光画笔颜色增强：自定义色号、RGB 选择器、单色随机、全部随机、彩虹、2～8 色空间渐变和闪烁。
  • 渐变与闪烁分别保存颜色数量和颜色列表，切换模式不会互相覆盖。
  • 闪烁速度支持 1.0～10.0、0.1 步进，并可在 1.0 至所选上限之间随机变速。
  • 在白名单基础上新增独立的手写笔鼠标生效范围。
  • 白名单、黑名单和手写笔鼠标范围有未保存修改时，返回会询问是否保存。
  • 新增快捷环延迟、激光唤出和输入兼容性等随机小提示。

修复与整理

  • 修复重新落笔导致旧渐变轨迹重新变色的问题。
  • 修复用手指或笔尖关闭虚拟激光/手写笔鼠标后，模块状态未同步、四次轻捏无法再次唤出的问题。
  • 清理已删除的充电防误触残留配置和无效备份规则，修正文案与 README。

本模块不修改系统文件；关闭模块或卸载并重启后恢复系统原始行为。

English

Added

  • Color enhancements for Xiaomi's original laser brush: custom hex colors, RGB picker, per-color and all-color randomization, rainbow, 2–8 color spatial gradients, and flashing.
  • Gradient and flashing modes now store separate color counts and color lists.
  • Flashing speed from 1.0 to 10.0 in 0.1 increments, plus optional random speed between 1.0 and the selected limit.
  • A separate stylus-mouse scope selected from the allowlist.
  • Save confirmation when leaving modified allowlist, blacklist, or stylus-mouse scope pages.
  • Additional randomized tips for shortcut-ring delay, laser activation, and input compatibility.

Fixed and cleaned up

  • Starting a new stroke no longer recolors existing spatial-gradient strokes.
  • Finger or pen-tip exits now synchronize virtual-laser/stylus-mouse state, allowing the four-pinch gesture to activate it again.
  • Removed obsolete charging-guard configuration and redundant backup rules; corrected UI and README text.

The module does not modify system files. Disabling or uninstalling it and rebooting restores the original system behavior.

releases.name: Pixel Suite 3.0.0
releases.descriptionHTML:
Pixel Suite 3.0.0

The biggest Pixel Suite release yet. 3.0.0 brings a smarter share menu, a reimagined Pixel Studio, icon packs, call recording, system-wide ad blocking, Do Not Annoy, OTA & Play Store blockers, navigation buttons and much more, shaped across 191 preview builds. It also fixes bugs in Google's own apps, works with more Pixel Launcher versions, and gives the Pixel Suite app a fresh new look.

✨ Highlights

  • 📤 Share menu tools: reorder pinned apps and contacts, hide apps and contacts into folders
  • 🖼️ Pixel Studio, reimagined: zoom, an all-new text tool, the whole picture after a crop, floating colour menu
  • 🎨 Icon packs for Pixel Launcher, in your icon shape
  • 📞 Call recording in the Google Phone app, in any country, without the announcement
  • 🚫 Ad blocking system-wide, in Chrome and Google News, plus an ad-free Google feed
  • 🔕 Do Not Annoy: silence incoming calls while staying connected
  • 🛡️ OTA & Store blocker: keep your system and chosen apps on their current versions
  • ⌚ Pixel Watch eSIM setup with a QR code, in any country
  • 🧭 Navigation buttons beside the gesture bar
  • 🍞 Toasts: choose where every toast appears
  • 📱 More Pixel Launchers supported, and fixes for bugs in Google's own apps

📤 Share menu (Share menu > Share sheet tools)

  • Reorder pinned apps by dragging; extra pinned rows when one is full. Pinned apps aren't listed twice.
  • Hide apps into a Hidden apps folder, one by one or several at once with Edit. Tap a hidden app to share to it; long-press to unhide.
  • Contacts: reorder pinned contacts, hide contacts into a Hidden contacts folder, or fold the whole contacts row away.
  • Long app names stay on one line. Folders and panels follow your surface style and theme.
  • Google Photos' share page now uses the share sheet's own colours instead of plain white.

🖼️ Pixel Studio, reimagined

  • Zoom: pinch to zoom up to 5x and pan, anywhere in the editor. While zoomed, the pen, highlighter and eraser draw right under your finger, and crop corners stay under it. Save and Share are unaffected.
  • All-new text tool: type right on the picture, live, in your chosen font and colour.
    • Only ✓ saves, in the top bar or on the text's frame; ✕ deletes.
    • A saved text keeps a frame: drag to move it, side handles re-wrap the words, corner handles resize it. Two fingers on a text zoom the picture, like anywhere else.
    • A floating fonts and colours menu above the tool bar or keyboard, compact or full width, that you can drag or flick.
    • Typing on a cropped picture shows the cropped part right above the keyboard.
  • The whole picture after a crop: other tools keep the picture in place, the cropped part where the box was and the rest softly blurred around it.
  • Crop from any tool: grab a crop corner from any page and keep dragging.
  • Pen stays inside the crop: after a crop, strokes stay within the cropped area.
  • Floating colour menu for the pen and highlighter, in the style of the Doodles menu.
  • The tool bar is always there, also while a text or sticker is selected.
  • Pen strokes on top of texts, stickers and Doodles' shapes, on screen and when saved.
  • Sticker grabbers: resize stickers from their corners, with undo.
  • One menu at a time: the pen, colour, text and Doodles menus close each other.
  • Doodles: two fingers now zoom and pan the picture; small shapes move without growing. After a crop, new shapes are drawn only inside the cropped part (existing ones can still be moved anywhere).
  • Crop only from the four corners, so swiping in from an edge no longer crops by accident.

The new text tool needs Pixel Studio 2.3.001; on other versions, Pixel Studio's own text tool is used.

🎨 Icons

Icon packs (Themes > Choose Icon pack)

  • Use any standard icon pack from the Play Store or sideloaded (ADW / Nova / Lawnchair format).
  • Covers the home screen, folders, the dock, the app drawer and drawer search.
  • Every pack icon is trimmed and cut into the icon shape you chose in Wallpaper & style, with clean, smooth edges in every shape.
  • Apps the pack doesn't include keep their own icons, including themed icons. Packs that use Material You colours follow your phone's colours.
  • Changes apply live with a smooth crossfade, no launcher restart. Icons are prepared in advance, so scrolling stays smooth.
  • Pick one app's icon from any pack: long-press the app > Change icon > Icon pack, with search and the app's matching icons first. Reset icon goes back.

Colorful icons in the app drawer (Stock) (Themes > Change icons)

  • An option for a stock-looking drawer: with themed icons on, the app drawer, its suggestions, drawer search and drawer folders keep each app's own colours. The home screen stays themed.

💎 Google apps (Patreon)

Support Pixel Suite on Patreon and sign in inside the app to unlock these. Locked features are clearly marked and stay off until unlocked.

  • 📞 Call recording in the Google Phone app: works in any country, automatic or manual, and without the "This call is now being recorded" announcement. A copy of each recording is saved as M4A, named after the contact and time, in Recordings/Calls or a folder you choose.
  • 🚫 Ad blocker: blocks ad and tracker domains for every app and browser, even with Private DNS on, using the HaGeZi Multi LIGHT, AdAway and EasyList lists, updated daily.
    • Chrome: ads on web pages are hidden with EasyList's element rules, so no empty boxes or gaps are left. "Allow ads" and "turn off your ad blocker" pop-ups, sticky ad bars and floating video ads are removed too, and the page scrolls normally again.
    • Chrome's new-tab feed: sponsored stories disappear completely as you scroll, and so do the "Is this a good recommendation for you?" prompts.
    • Google News: cleaner articles, without ads.
  • 📰 Hide ads in Google feed: sponsored cards in Discover (and the launcher's left page) disappear completely, frame and gap included.

The pass is checked on your phone and works within seconds, no restart.

🔕 Do Not Annoy

Silence every incoming call while your phone stays connected. Data, Wi-Fi, outgoing calls and messages keep working.

  • On Pixels with Pixel's calling stack (Pixel 10 and later), callers hear that your phone is switched off or unavailable. On other phones, calls are declined.
  • Emergency calls always ring.
  • Each silenced call shows a notification with a Call back button and a call log entry.
  • Quick Settings tile included.
  • Pixel Watch with LTE: also turns your watch's own mobile network off and back on, with the Pixel Suite Watch app (separate download).

🛡️ OTA & Store blocker

  • OTA blocker: stops system update checks and downloads, and removes Software updates from Settings. Lock factory reset greys out Erase all data while it's on.
  • Play Store blocker: chosen apps stay on their current version; the Play Store never updates them. Core Pixel apps are held back unless you choose Unlock OEM apps, and uninstalling or disabling them asks for your fingerprint or PIN.

⌚ Pixel Watch eSIM

eSIM setup with a QR code (Google apps > Pixel watch): the Pixel Watch app offers Scan QR code under Mobile network, even where Google says "No carrier supported". A one-time $10 purchase, yours to keep on your phone; Patreon is not required.

🧭 Navigation buttons (Gestures > Navigation buttons)

A hybrid navigation bar: the gesture pill stays, with a button on each side.

  • Choose the left and right buttons: Back, Home, Recent apps or none.
  • Hold Home for: Circle to Search, Gemini or nothing.
  • Buttons follow the pill's light and dark colour and hide on the lock screen.
  • With the keyboard open, the Back arrow turns down to close it.
  • Swipes from the pill still go Home and to Recents. Taps are instant, with roomy touch areas.

🍞 Toasts (Pixel Launcher > Toasts)

Choose where every toast message appears: Top (as before), Middle, or Bottom (Stock), where Android puts it. All toasts follow your choice, in your surface style and theme.

⚙️ Miscellaneous

  • Refresh rate slider: a 60 / 120 Hz slider under Smooth display in Settings > Display & touch. The screen still drops to its lowest rate when nothing moves.
  • Show FPS: a live frame counter at the top right for the app in front.
  • Backup & restore (About and support): save your whole setup to one file (every setting, drawer folders and sorting, renamed apps, custom icons and share menu choices) and restore it anytime, even after clearing Pixel Launcher's storage or a factory reset. Patreon sign-in and the eSIM purchase aren't included; they stay tied to your account, and Patreon features only switch back on with an active Patreon pass.
  • Allow screenshots of secure screens and Hide accessibility from apps are now built entirely on Pixel Suite's own code, with the same behaviour.

💠 A fresh look

  • Pixel Suite app redesign: a new home header, colour-coded sections, search across every setting, panels that fit the screen, soft frosted scrolling edges, and an LSPosed scope guide on each feature page that lists exactly which apps to select.
  • Super Dark-Mode, deeper: the app's sheets, dialogs, menus and fields share one pure-black palette, and pills and toasts are white on black.
  • Glass rims: Frosted Glass panels, folders, menus, toasts and dialogs get a soft glass edge in light and dark theme, and Super Dark's soft rim in Super Dark-Mode, now also on Settings pop-ups. Blur Off keeps plain panels.
  • Soft frosted scrolling edges (Frosted Glass) across the whole Settings app and the screens it opens (Google, Wallpaper & style, Permissions, Digital Wellbeing, Pixel Troubleshooting, Personal Safety), and in the app drawer, where apps fade softly under the search bar as you scroll.
  • The app drawer always shows its All apps label under the suggestions.
  • Open folders show their name in bold, on the left, and folders in the app drawer lift when you hold them, like apps.
  • Remove, Cancel and Uninstall light up with an outline as an app reaches them, one at a time. Several selected apps fly into them together.

📱 More Pixel Launchers supported

Pixel Suite now works across more Pixel Launcher versions, including the newest builds with the redesigned app menu. Every feature is loaded on its own, so if a launcher version changes something one feature relies on, the others keep working.

  • Pixel Suite's menu options (Create folder, Change icon, Rename, Lock) show on the new Pixel Launcher menu, and Hide app shortcuts works there too.
  • Fixed a Pixel Launcher crash when opening an app's menu on newer launcher builds.
  • Fixed dragging apps out of the app list, drawer folders and icon label sizing on newer launcher builds.
  • Clear all, folder reordering, locked-app and folder protection, and the home screen's Pixel Suite settings row are adapted to the changes in newer launcher builds.

🐞 Bug fixes

  • Pixel Studio: after typing a text and pressing ✓, opening Doodles or another tool could add a copy of the text.
  • Double tap to sleep: right after a reboot, typing your PIN could turn the screen off.
  • Custom and icon-pack icons: swiping an app away no longer briefly shows the stock icon flying back.
  • Custom and icon-pack icons: a closed folder's small icons no longer snap to the themed icons at the end of the closing animation.
  • Pixel Launcher: after moving several apps at once, Remove or Cancel could overlap Uninstall on the next drag.

🛠️ Google & Pixel bugs fixed

Bugs in Google's own apps that Pixel Suite now fixes:

  • Pixel Launcher: themed icons had hard, stepped edges with a thin light rim in every icon shape. They're now drawn smooth, like normal icons.
  • Pixel Launcher: closing a folder from its second (or later) page with a non-round icon shape (arch, cookie, clover…) blanked the page while the first page's icons trailed outside the folder. Folders now close cleanly from any page, in every shape.
  • Pixel Studio: dragging a crop corner made a selected text jump around. It stays still now.
  • Pixel Studio: tapping a text or sticker on the crop page threw away your crop. Your crop is kept.
  • Pixel Studio: the tool bar disappeared while a text or sticker was selected. It stays.
  • Pixel Studio: picking a pen could fold the tool bar down to that one pen. Fixed.
  • Pixel Studio: selecting a text or sticker covered the pen strokes drawn before it. Strokes stay visible.

🔒 Privacy

Pixel Suite has no ads, analytics or tracking, and the module itself never connects to the internet. The Pixel Suite app goes online only for:

  • checking for Pixel Suite updates on GitHub (you can turn this off);
  • downloading the Ad blocker's lists, while the Ad blocker is on;
  • Patreon sign-in and pass renewal, if you sign in

    ...

releases.name: Pixel Suite v2.0.8
releases.descriptionHTML:
Pixel Suite v2.0.8

A polish and bug-fix update for the screenshot editor, launcher folders and recents, including fixes for bugs in Pixel Studio and Pixel Launcher themselves.

✨ New

  • Crop blur (Pixel Studio): cropping now blurs the part you're cutting away, live as you drag, instead of just dimming it. Drag back out and it's sharp again.
  • Outlined crop corners: the four corner marks have an outline, so they're easy to see on light and dark screenshots, in your theme's colour.
  • Undo for drawer folders: removing a drawer folder now shows "Item removed Undo", like the home screen. Undo puts it back with its apps, name, grid, sort and lock.

🎨 Polish

  • Pixel Studio, Frosted Glass (light theme): the tool bar, pen size bar, font bar, trash button and Doodles menu now share one frost, and open with their final look, with no shade shift or blink.
  • Pixel Studio: Undo stays faded until there's something to undo. Redo is always shown clearly.
  • Pixel Studio: tapping another tool (pen, highlighter, eraser, crop, text) closes Doodles at once.
  • Pixel Studio: the Doodles menu fades only while your finger is near it.
  • Google Photos: the photo editor's "Discard changes?" dialog now follows your style: frosted with Frosted Glass, light on a light phone, black with the soft rim under Super Dark.
  • Landscape recents: "App is locked", "Two apps locked", "App remains locked" and "Cannot dismiss locked apps" read the right way up, centred in the blurred strip below the cards.

🐞 Bug fixes

  • Recents: the status bar flickered while scrolling past apps last used in landscape (Android 17 turns their cards), and again after long use.
  • Recents: memory leak. Pixel Launcher kept a picture of every split-screen card until it restarted.
  • Home screen (Frosted Glass): an app dragged onto a folder went behind the folder once it opened, so it couldn't be dropped in.
  • An app dragged onto Remove and then off it stayed see-through.
  • A locked drawer folder dragged to the home screen came out unlocked.
  • Pixel Studio: on a fresh screenshot, Undo looked available and could undo the previous screenshot's doodles.
  • Pixel Studio: with Doodles open, dragging a crop corner sometimes drew an arrow instead of cropping.
  • Pixel Studio: with a pen open, Doodles drew pen strokes instead of shapes.
  • Pixel Studio: the Doodles menu flickered on every drag.
  • Pixel Studio: after cropping, the Doodles menu couldn't be dragged back to its place above the tool bar.
  • Pixel Studio: every crop change made the Doodles menu vanish and pop back.

🛠️ Google & Pixel bugs fixed

Bugs in Google's own apps that Pixel Suite now fixes:

  • Pixel Studio: the top bar (Delete, Undo, Redo, Share, Save) blinked while you dragged the crop corners. It stays put now, and ✓ / X work as usual.
  • Pixel Studio: the crop button changed a moment after the editor opened (its highlight and bolder icon came in late). It looks the same from the first frame now (Frosted Glass, light theme).
  • Pixel Launcher: after split screen in landscape, Screenshot / Select / Clear all sat lower in portrait recents, then snapped into place. They're in their place from the first frame now.
  • Pixel Launcher: Undo after removing a home folder didn't bring the folder back. Now it grows back into its place (with its page, if it was alone there), and a locked folder gets its lock back.

Setup

Update and reboot. Keep the recommended LSPosed scope (with Pixel Studio and Google Photos).
Tested on Pixel 11 Pro, Android 17, Pixel Launcher 17.

releases.descriptionHTML:
What's new in 4.0

XReply is now part of XNotify. XNotify now also gives Telegram, WhatsApp, Instagram and every other notification HyperOS's own reply box and buttons, instead of Android's.

  • Xiaomi reply box: Xiaomi's rounded reply box with a round send button, which turns blue when you type.
  • Xiaomi buttons: Action buttons such as Reply and Like look like Xiaomi's own.
  • Sent replies show up: If an app (like Telegram) does not update its notification after you reply, your reply is shown in it and the spinner stops.
  • Settings screen: Tap the settings button next to XNotify in LSPosed. Turn tablet forwarding and the reply box on or off separately. Changes apply after a reboot.
Xiaomi buttons Xiaomi reply box Settings

Using XReply?
Uninstall XReply, install XNotify 4.0 and reboot. While XReply is still installed, XNotify leaves the reply box to it, so the same change is not applied twice.

Updating from 3.x?
Install over the old version and reboot. The reply box uses the System UI scope XNotify already has.

4.0 sürümünde yenilikler

XReply artık XNotify'ın içinde. XNotify, Telegram, WhatsApp, Instagram ve diğer tüm bildirimlere Android'in kutusu yerine HyperOS'un kendi yanıt kutusunu ve butonlarını da getirir.

  • Xiaomi yanıt kutusu: Xiaomi'nin yuvarlak yanıt kutusu ve yazınca maviye dönen yuvarlak gönder butonu.
  • Xiaomi butonları: Yanıtla, Beğen gibi butonlar Xiaomi'nin kendi butonları gibi görünür.
  • Gönderilen yanıt görünür: Uygulama (ör. Telegram) yanıttan sonra bildirimini güncellemezse yanıtınız bildirimde gösterilir, dönen simge durur.
  • Ayar ekranı: LSPosed'da XNotify'ın yanındaki ayar düğmesine dokunun. Tablete aktarmayı ve yanıt kutusunu ayrı ayrı açıp kapatın. Değişiklikler yeniden başlatmadan sonra geçerli olur.

XReply kullanıyor musunuz?
XReply'ı kaldırın, XNotify 4.0'ı kurun ve yeniden başlatın. XReply yüklü kaldıkça XNotify yanıt kutusuna dokunmaz, böylece aynı değişiklik iki kez uygulanmaz.

3.x'ten mi güncelliyorsunuz?
Eski sürümün üzerine kurun ve yeniden başlatın. Yanıt kutusu, XNotify'ın zaten sahip olduğu System UI kapsamını kullanır.

Feedback / Geri bildirim: @emcleek

releases.descriptionHTML:
1.1.1

Video Boost uploads work as intended again, Reclaim finishes reliably, and the Reclaim page is
redesigned in the Material 3 Expressive style.

Fixes

  • Video Boost uploads. After the Reclaim page was opened or a scan ran, Video Boost uploads were
    sent with the Pixel XL identity instead of the phone's own, so Google treated them as unlimited
    Original quality uploads. The phone's real model is now captured once at startup and kept.
    Each Video Boost upload logs the model it was sent with.
  • Reclaim finishing. A reclaim could stop after the upload with "Something went wrong" when
    Photos' account check on the server reply failed. PPE now accepts that check for its own write,
    so the new copy is recorded and linked to the video on the phone.
  • Reclaim page crash. Opening the page could close Google Photos. Fixed.

What's new

  • Compatibility & diagnostics has a Video Boost identity row: the model Video Boost uploads
    are sent as, the model of the last upload, and whether it matches the phone.
  • Summary. Storage in use as a large number, with the selected size next to it. One line below
    shows how many photos and videos the scan checked, or a status that matters.
  • Scan. Scan Video Boost, with a wavy indicator while scanning.
  • Videos. Shown once a scan finds videos that use storage. Newest, Oldest, Largest
    and Smallest sort the list; each video is its own card with a larger thumbnail.
  • Selection. Select all, Deselect all and Invert selection sit next to Reclaim
    selected     in the bottom bar, which shows only while you pick videos. The overflow menu is gone.
  • Confirmation. A new dialog with the amount to free, the four steps and the cautions.
  • Progress. The card shows the current video's thumbnail, step and bytes. Its circular
    indicator fills during download and upload and spins on the other steps. Pause and
    Resume are in the card.
  • History. Date and size, "On device" on its own line, and a short result ("Cloud copy
    replaced." or "Not completed."). Thumbnails come from the phone, or from the cloud copy when the
    phone has none.
  • About reclaim is two short lines. New text is translated into all ten languages.

1.1.0

Support for Google Photos 7.98, a rebuilt Video Boost Storage Reclaim, ten languages, and a module
that keeps working across Photos updates.

What's new

  • Google Photos 7.98 support. Unlimited Original Quality, Unlimited Storage Saver, Video Boost
    uploads and Storage Reclaim all work on Photos 7.98.0.1007591100.
  • Survives Photos updates. PPE finds the Photos classes it hooks with DexKit at runtime, so most
    Photos updates need no new module build. If something can't be found, Photos keeps its own
    behaviour and Compatibility & diagnostics shows what is unavailable.
  • Video Boost Storage Reclaim, rebuilt.
    • Scan for boosted videos that use storage, select them, and reclaim. PPE downloads each video,
      deletes the cloud copy (also from Trash) and uploads it again with your Backup setting.
    • A confirmation dialog explains each step, a progress card shows the current video and step, and
      a history list keeps past results.
    • A safe copy stays on the phone until each video is done, and an interrupted run can be resumed.
  • Ten languages. English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, Español, Português, Русский, 日本語, 한국어,
    Bahasa Indonesia and Bahasa Melayu. PPE follows the phone language or the per-app language set for
    Google Photos.
  • Restart now. Changing the backup mode offers a one-tap restart of Photos instead of a manual
    force-stop. It isn't offered while Reclaim is running.
  • Cleaner settings.
    • No back arrow.
    • Pixel model is greyed out while Unlimited Original Quality is on.
    • The Video Boost description is corrected.
    • Shorter labels throughout.

Fixes and performance

  • The PPE card now appears in the profile menu when Photos is in any language, not only English.
  • About 7% less CPU in Photos' first seconds after launch:
    • A redundant compatibility scan no longer runs at every start.
    • Repeat policy checks are cached instead of starting a process each time.
    • A per-label resource lookup was removed from the main thread.
  • The Brainfuck policy is now built by current BBC (BFX format 2), with output identical to before.

Requirements

Android 17 (API 37) ARM64, libxposed API 102 (tested with Vector 2.2), Google Photos
7.98.0.1007591100 (tested). Scope: com.google.android.apps.photos. After installing or updating,
force-stop Google Photos and open it again.

Reuploaded videos lose their Video Boost tags and links. Google decides backup eligibility and how
storage is counted, on its servers. Check your account storage after enabling a backup option.

releases.name: v1.5.3
releases.descriptionHTML:
1.5.3 更新说明

  • 新增“多日天气预报横向布局”开关，采用水平七日样式，按星期、日期、天气图标及高低温纵向排列；平板卡片占满整行，其他天气卡片在主网格中排列。关闭开关保留原生布局和列数。
  • 修复平板双栏合并控制中心影响锁屏通知显示和清空按钮显隐的问题；锁屏恢复原生排版，解锁后重新应用分栏，布局恢复不再覆盖系统控制的显隐和动画状态。
  • 字体配置挂载改为按应用选择，默认包含 Chrome 和当前 WebView 提供程序，支持添加、移除应用及显示系统应用；处理选中应用的子进程和网页渲染进程。
  • 完善字体挂载的旧配置清理、事务回退及等待机制，减少对未选中应用的影响，并保留字体操作失败日志，便于排查。

1.5.2 更新说明

  • 隐藏通知列表右侧改为显示当前状态“未隐藏”“已隐藏”，同步繁体中文和英文文案；点击仍切换隐藏状态，无障碍操作说明保持明确。

1.5.1 更新说明

  • 平板分栏合并控制中心上滑收起时，卡片和磁贴跟随面板进度执行原生显隐动画，同时保持完整的分栏磁贴布局。
  • 统一模块设置标题栏的最小高度，无按钮的左栏与有按钮的右栏等高，标题保持垂直居中。
  • 更新隐藏通知页面的连接提示，服务未连接时可尝试关闭通知访问权限后重新授予。

1.5.0 更新说明

主要更新：平板与宽屏适配

模块设置双栏界面

  • 宽屏下采用左侧分类导航、右侧设置详情的双栏布局，左右栏按 4:7 分配空间；默认展示桌面设置，当前分类高亮显示，切换功能时保留左侧导航。
  • 隐藏应用列表、导航栏沉浸应用列表、停用应用和隐藏通知等页面可在右侧直接操作，页面切换保留层级与过渡动画。
  • 根据当前窗口宽度自动选择单栏或双栏布局，适应平板、手机横屏和窗口尺寸变化；内容避让屏幕挖孔，充分利用可显示区域。
  • 宽屏确认对话框居中显示，内容最大宽度为 480dp；窄屏继续采用底部对话框，保持与手机操作习惯一致。

合并控制中心左右布局

  • 新增“合并通控中心左右布局”，平板横屏时将通知放在左侧、控制中心放在右侧，同时浏览通知与操作快捷开关。手机对应选项为“合并通控中心横屏左右交换”。
  • 头部贯穿左右两栏，通知顶部与控制中心卡片区域对齐；清除通知按钮在通知区域水平居中，内容依据屏幕挖孔安全区排列。
  • 两栏作为整体居中，控制中心最大宽度为 400dp、通知区域最大宽度为 540dp；可用空间不足时按比例收缩，适应不同屏幕宽度与显示密度。
  • 分栏控制中心采用完整展开的四列布局，磁贴编辑界面同步采用四列；非分栏平板支持六列磁贴，卡片、图标及间距依据对应网格计算比例。
  • 栏间距支持 4%～6% 调整，默认 5%、步长 0.5%；非分栏平板在该设置基础上减去 2 个百分点，提供更紧凑的大屏排列。
  • 新增“合并中心显示播控时前两磁贴置顶”，将前两张快捷磁贴排列在播放控件上方，同时支持手机布局及横屏／平板分栏布局。前两张磁贴的文字保留系统字号。

平板任务栏手势

  • 将手势条宽度调整、增大底部手势区高度、mBack 和避免手势区域点击穿透扩展至平板任务栏手势条。
  • mBack 复用任务栏的返回与主屏幕导航能力，滑动操作继续交给原生手势处理；相关设置支持动态更新。
  • 手势条长按行为与模块选项保持一致，可配合 mBack 使用。

其他新增与优化

  • 新增“隐藏通知”页面，分别列出已隐藏和未隐藏的通知，支持按条隐藏、取消隐藏与手动刷新，并提供通知访问权限入口。通知内容仅用于本机显示，不上传或保存到文件。
  • 系统字体操作按顺序处理，导入和准备完成时提供状态提示；从模块重启 Zygote 前等待字体配置与挂载完成，准备失败时保留当前运行状态并提示原因。
  • 一键启用“彻底隐藏应用”时，为已安装且具有桌面入口的电话本与 Gboard 补充默认隐藏项；一键启用不再更改屏幕旋转建议设置。

releases.name: v3.2 灵动坞OS
releases.descriptionHTML:
这次更新

  • 悬浮球坞窗：点悬浮球从侧边滑出一列卡片，一次看到所有悬浮球里的应用，点哪张就恢复哪个
  • 卡片画面：默认显示截图，勾选过的应用显示实时画面
  • 后台保活：应用收进悬浮球后继续运行，声音和画面不中断
  • 智能侧边栏：解除编辑模式最多添加 20 个应用/工具的限制（原 sidebar-hook 已并入）
  • 坞窗卡片按应用比例显示；后台保活的应用按 60 帧显示
  • 设置页新增「实时画面」「后台保活」「动态应用」三项，支持深色主题
  • 更名「灵动坞OS」，新图标

作用域：系统框架（android）、系统界面（com.android.systemui）；侧边栏功能另需智能侧边栏（com.coloros.smartsidebar）。勾选后重启手机一次。

modules.name: io.github.cnnceart.flymeears
modules.description: FlymeEars - 第三方耳机接入魅族耳机 App
modules.summary: FlymeEars 1.0.0｜把 OPPO Enco X2 等第三方蓝牙耳机接进魅族耳机 App（Flyme）：原生弹窗、设备列表、电量、降噪、编码与自定义 EQ。

releases.descriptionHTML:
首个正式版（1.0.0，versionCode 10000）。

已在魅族 21 Pro（Flyme 12.6 / Android 16）+ OPPO Enco X2（固件 154.154.120）实机验证。

新增能力

  • 设备双连：原生「设备双连」页开关下发 0x0403，页面列出耳机记录的设备（来自 0x0112），开关状态随耳机重启/回连保持
  • LDAC：高品质音频页在 AAC / LHDC 之外注入第三行 LDAC（0x041A + 0x0114 回读）
  • 自定义 EQ：声效调节 → 自定义打开原生 10 段曲线页，折叠成耳机 6 段补偿曲线下发（0x0411 + 0x040E + 0x0116/0x0415 + 0x0403 0B）
  • 设备中心卡片：电量、降噪、连接状态、耳机图标全部可用，打开即刷新
  • 状态回传改为模拟魅族 SDK 回调链：页面不再被直接调用，断开/重连、切编码、切 EQ 都由回调驱动刷新

修复

  • 充电状态在断链（进盒、关盖、盒子插电）时不再闪；盒内按「在盒=充电」推断
  • 卡片降噪切换不再回弹，重复指令已去重
  • 断连后卡片状态立即刷新；卡片右上角状态图标可断开耳机（同时断开 A2DP）
  • 卡片名称统一为蓝牙全名；图标替换为 Enco X2 黑色盒图
  • 状态轮询从 30s 调整为 6s；连接回调限流 10s，避免反复弹原生连接弹窗

已知限制

  • 自定义 EQ 为近似映射，听感建议自测
  • 充电状态在盒内靠推断，进盒瞬间可能有 2–3 秒延迟
  • 降噪切换需佩戴耳机

modules.name: io.github.re_televip.televip
modules.summary: Privacy, ad blocking and quality-of-life features for Telegram and its forks: Ghost Mode, deleted messages, protected media saving and more.

releases.descriptionHTML:
New

  • Always show Downloads. A new switch under UI. The Downloads button stays at the top of the chat list, even when nothing is downloading, so your files are one tap away. It still steps aside while you search. Restart the app after turning it on.
  • Show user ID, your way. Show user ID now has two options: On my profile and On other profiles. Turn on just the one you want. Whatever you had before carries over to both.
  • Bahasa Indonesia. Re: TeleVIP now speaks Indonesian. Pick it under Language, or it follows your app when the app is in Indonesian.

Install

  1. Download TeleVip-…-release.apk below and install it (uninstall a debug build first).
  2. In Vector 2.2+: Modules → enable Re: TeleVIP → tick your Telegram clients.
  3. Force stop the client and reopen it.

No root? Patch your Telegram client with LSPatch 1.2 (JingMatrix) and add Re: TeleVIP to it.

The source code of this version is in Re-TeleVIP-…-source.zip below (GPL-3.0).

Thank you for the reports in the group.

Fixed

  • Forwarding from chats that restrict saving content works. With Remove content-saving restrictions on, these messages said "forwarded" but then failed with a red mark. They're now sent as your own copy: text and captions as new messages, and photos and files uploaded again from what's already on your phone. If a photo or file isn't downloaded yet, download it first.
  • Turrit stops asking "Open Re: TeleVIP settings now?" at every start and account switch once the Re: TeleVIP row is in its settings or side menu. The prompt also has a Don't show again button.
  • Your own profile stays centred on Telegram 13's new profile page with Hide online or Show user ID on, when it opens and after you scroll. Show user ID now shows your own ID there too.
  • The Re: TeleVIP row in Forkgram Classic's side menu opens the settings again (Forkgram Classic 13.0.2). Tapping it did nothing.

Install

  1. Download TeleVip-…-release.apk below and install it (uninstall a debug build first).
  2. In Vector 2.2+: Modules → enable Re: TeleVIP → tick your Telegram clients.
  3. Force stop the client and reopen it.

No root? Patch your Telegram client with LSPatch 1.2 (JingMatrix) and add Re: TeleVIP to it.

The source code of this version is in Re-TeleVIP-…-source.zip below (GPL-3.0).

New

  • Show read time. A new switch under Messages. In private chats, each of your messages that was read shows when, like "Read 12:41", with the day if it was read on another day. Checking this never marks anything as read, so Ghost Mode keeps working. Telegram only tells for the last 7 days, and not when either of you hides read times; those messages keep their usual ticks.
  • Support goes straight to Patreon's membership page, where you can pick a tier: Buy me a Coffee? ($5), Big Fan! ($10) or Super Fan!! ($25).
  • Made in Saudi 🇸🇦 By: i_2B_4G10🚀 now sits at the bottom of the settings.

Fixed

  • Disable stories hides the stories row again on Telegram 13.1. The row at the top of the chat list stayed visible on that version.
  • Edits history works in groups, including edits made while the group wasn't open or your phone was offline. If a message is edited several times while you're offline, Telegram only delivers the final text, so the versions in between can't be kept.
  • Arabic and Persian dialogs read right to left. The buttons in Clear saved data and other dialogs are now in the right order when Re: TeleVIP is in Arabic or Persian.

Install

  1. Download TeleVip-…-release.apk below and install it (uninstall a debug build first).
  2. In Vector 2.2+: Modules → enable Re: TeleVIP → tick your Telegram clients.
  3. Force stop the client and reopen it.

No root? Patch your Telegram client with LSPatch 1.2 (JingMatrix) and add Re: TeleVIP to it.

The source code of this version is in Re-TeleVIP-…-source.zip below (GPL-3.0).

⚠️ New package name: uninstall the old version. The module's package is now io.github.the_marox.hyperdesktop (it was io.maurizio.hyperdesktop), as required by the official LSPosed module repository. Android treats it as a different app, so it won't replace the old one:

Install this APK.

The module's settings start from the defaults. If the old version is still installed, the new settings app shows a warning with a button to uninstall it.

releases.name: v1.0.4
releases.descriptionHTML:
v1.0.4 — 2026-10-30

Version Code: 104300
Tag: v1.0.4

围场计时赛从「能看榜」长成完整生态：车手主页、圈速详情、账号设置与围场指南全部落地；新增抓地力与路肩两套触觉反馈。本版起只支持共存版，并新增围场登录门控——未登录时游戏内不加载任何功能。

Breaking Changes

  • 仅支持共存版：官方原版（com.Vince.AlamobileFormula）已停止维护，本版只支持共存版 com.Takotsubo.AlamobileFormula。装官方原版的用户请改用共存版。
  • 游戏包版本需精确匹配：要求 8.0.6 Fix 3（versionCode 200150）。旧共存包（Fix 1 / Fix 2）需重新下载最新共存包，否则模块零 Hook 并循环提示。
  • NPatch 需 850：框架与管理器版本都必须是 850，更早版本会被拦截。
  • 使用前必须登录围场：未登录时模块在游戏内不安装任何 Hook，游戏照常运行但所有功能不生效。这是有意的门控，不是故障。
  • 模块落后会被拦截：模块版本低于最新 Release 时同样零 Hook 并提示更新。

Features

  • 围场生态扩展：新增车手主页（概览 / 计时赛 / 大奖赛三页）、赛道榜点行弹出圈速详情（含车型与 13 项车辆调教）、账号设置（更换头像 / 修改用户名 / 屏蔽缺失配置的记录）、围场指南、忘记用户名，排行榜支持分页与下拉刷新
  • 车型与调教上传：有效圈自动采集车型与车辆调教并随成绩上传，在圈速详情中展示
  • 抓地力反馈（实验性）：把轮胎的纵向滑移、横向滑移、后轮空转、车身侧滑角与四轮饱和翻译成振动强度与屏幕下缘的弓形光斑。1/4 强度代表最佳抓地力，打滑、空转与锁死达到最大强度。可单独开关振感与视觉，并调节最大强度与不透明度
  • 路肩振感反馈（实验性）：压过路肩时按车速给出粗粒度振动，车速越快颗粒越密。默认关闭，开启时会提示它会覆盖抓地力振感
  • 自动 DRS 与 AA：在游戏允许开启动减阻系统与主动空力套件的时机自动开启，无需手动按
  • 自锁式超车按键：超车按钮从「按住才生效」改为「点一下切换」，长距离超车不必一直按着；能否开启仍由游戏判定
  • 禁止删除下一圈成绩：冲出赛道限制时只作废本圈，不再连带作废下一圈，默认开启
  • 解除最大转向角度限制：解除「车速越高最大转角越小」的限制，开启时会弹出驾驶特性警示
  • 修复 DLC 更新超时卡加载：网络异常时不再卡在启动加载界面，默认开启
  • 配置页重构：首页拆成四张入口卡片（原生特性控制 / Overlay 控件 / 响应曲线 / 杂项），各自独立成页
  • 崩溃自捕：模块进程未捕获异常与游戏进程原生崩溃都会自动落盘，随日志导出带出，不需要 adb
  • 启动环境信息：日志开头记录构建时间、提交号、设备与 ROM 信息，便于定位问题
  • 辅助配置逐维判定：圈中修改某一项设置时只把该项标记为「无效」，不再整圈作废
  • 排行榜零辅助标识：TC 与 ABS 全关的最快圈以金色流光标识

Bug Fixes

  • 修复了编辑模式调整踏板位置后，触摸判定仍停留在旧位置的问题
  • 修复了双踏板模式下松开刹车后油门延迟恢复或不恢复的问题
  • 修复了踏板与抓地力反馈导致的掉帧与锁 30 帧问题
  • 修复了关闭运行时开关后功能仍生效、必须重启游戏的问题
  • 修复了游戏启动 15 秒内修改的配置被启动快照覆盖的问题
  • 修复了弱网或断网时圈速上传失败导致成绩丢失的问题，现在失败一律入本地队列并自动补传
  • 修复了 NPatch 下登录态误判、需要反复登录的问题
  • 修复了头像缓存反复自删、每次启动重新下载的问题
  • 修复了排行榜分页一次性拉取全部数据的问题
  • 修复了无谷歌服务的设备上无法选择头像图片的问题
  • 修复了关闭 ABS 时刹车指示灯不闪的问题
  • 修复了暂停游戏后抓地力振动持续不停的问题
  • 修复了排行榜数字列右对齐参差不齐的问题
  • 修复了配置页切换页面时改动丢失的问题
  • 修复了主屏切换页面时焦点凭空跳页的问题

Performance

  • 排行榜滚动重做：按行复用 + 头像降采样解码，200 人以上榜单流畅
  • 抓地力振感波形压缩为单段，减少与系统振动服务的通信开销
  • 日志改为异步落盘，消除写入时的帧阻塞

Known Issues

  • 手动换挡：相关 Hook 曾导致起步失败，当前禁用，待重新实现
  • 大奖赛 / 娱乐匹配：围场页占位入口，服务端赛程功能尚未实现
  • 弯道顿挫：通常来自游戏内置刹车辅助，建议在游戏设置中关闭；也可用模块的 ABS 干预强度与最大制动压力缓解
  • 抓地力反馈与路肩振感标注为实验性，手感仍在迭代

releases.name: v1.0.3
releases.descriptionHTML:
v1.0.3 — 2026-09-04

Version Code: 103300
Tag: v1.0.3

围场互联大版本：计时赛在线排行榜、通行证账号体系与圈速自动上传上线；全面适配 Ala Mobile 8.0.6。欢迎来围场一较高下！

Breaking Changes

  • 游戏版本门禁切至 8.0.6 (200150)：8.0.4 用户升级本版后模块不会生效——请务必将游戏更新至 8.0.6！

Features

  • 围场互联（Paddock）：模块 App 新增「围场」页——通行证账号（注册后按弹窗指令到 QQ 群发送校验消息完成建号）、忘记密码（群内发送重置口令获取重置码，回模块设置新密码）、计时赛在线排行榜（积分总榜 + 分赛道圈速榜，按游戏版本筛选）、个人头像裁剪上传、登录态持久化（重装游戏不丢）；自建服务端可在设置页配置
  • 积分排行规则：每赛道 × 每游戏版本独立排名，积分 round((N−rank)×100/N)（第一名 100 分、逐名递减），总榜为各版本积分之和
  • 圈速自动上传：计时赛有效圈过线瞬间自动上传，服务端判定全服最佳/版本最佳/个人最佳并弹 Toast 提示；仅计时赛会话生效，其他模式静默
  • 适配 Ala Mobile 8.0.6 (200150)：37 个 IL2CPP 偏移全量更新，修复新版本跑圈闪退
  • TC/ABS 介入指示灯：屏幕上缘椭圆弓形指示灯，TC 介入亮绿、ABS 介入亮红；信号取自游戏原生介入执行点，与实际介入节奏同频闪烁
  • 工具按钮位置记忆：拖动工具按钮后自动记忆位置，下次进游戏恢复
  • 最大制动压力语义升级：滑条改为「行程重映射 + 原生压力曲线封顶」——踏板行程按比例缩放，任何车速下压力上限仍遵循游戏原生曲线（与 ABS 档位完全解耦）

Bug Fixes

  • 修复了小米/红米 MIUI 设备上多指触摸导致踏板读数瞬间跳满的问题（双源坐标交叉校验）
  • 修复了「隐藏游戏原生油门/刹车按键」开关关闭后按钮不恢复的问题

Performance

  • 排行榜滚动重做：列表按行复用 + 头像降采样解码，200+ 人榜单滚动流畅不卡顿

releases.name: v1.0.2
releases.descriptionHTML:
v1.0.2 — 2026-08-29

Version Code: 102300
Tag: v1.0.2

新增 ABS、最大制动压力与牵引力控制调节功能，车辆辅助系统参数支持自定义；修复踏板控件显示与触控处理相关的多项问题。

Features

  • ABS 干预强度：新增「防抱死制动系统」设置，提供默认与自定义两种模式。自定义模式包含关闭 ABS / 低 / 中 / 高 / 最高（默认）五档干预强度，可在原厂保护强度与接近无干预之间调整制动表现；选择关闭 ABS 后，重刹车轮将直接抱死。
  • 最大制动压力：新增 50–100% 无级调节，按比例降低制动扭矩上限，用于缓解关闭 ABS 后重刹立即抱死的问题。该设置独立于 ABS 模式生效，关闭 ABS 时同样有效，且不影响踏板响应曲线。
  • 牵引力控制档位：新增削减强度（关闭 TC / 低 / 中 / 高 / 最高（默认））与介入时机（较晚（默认）/ 较早 / 非常早 / 实时）两组档位。介入时机调早后，起步打滑阶段 TC 同样介入。
  • 隐藏游戏原生油门/刹车按键：新增开关，可隐藏游戏自带的油门与刹车按钮（其他按键不受影响），以便使用模块踏板。
  • 踏板响应曲线求解升级：曲线切线求解算法升级，控制点之间的过渡更平滑，极端曲线下仍精确经过每个控制点；交互方式与已保存的曲线数据保持不变。
  • 配置页手势优化：新增页面级手势方向锁，左右滑动翻页与上下滚动页面互不干扰；拖动滑块时页面不再跟随滚动。
  • 触摸诊断日志：踏板控件新增触摸事件诊断日志（随「启用日志」开关记录），用于排查触屏问题；日志导出仅保留最近 24 小时的条目。

Bug Fixes

  • 修复半透明状态下踏板与换挡按钮的圆角边框与填充之间露出缝隙的问题
  • 修复关闭牵引力控制时影响 AI 车的问题
  • 修复开启日志后，换挡路径产生的大量冗余日志迅速占满日志文件的问题
  • 修复曲线编辑器中拖动控制点越过相邻控制点时，控制点位置互换、曲线显示异常的问题
  • 修复 ABS 警示弹窗关闭时缺少退出动画的问题
  • 修复 Android 10 以下系统读取多点触控坐标的兼容性问题

Known Issues

  • 多点触控下踏板数值跳变：本版对触控处理进行了改进，该问题尚未确认在所有机型上解决。若仍出现，请在设置中开启日志并导出反馈

modules.name: io.github.odomu.honorduo
modules.description: HonorDuo · 仿 iPhone Duo 三合一状态栏图标（HyperDuo移植适配MagicOS）
modules.summary: HonorDuo 将荣耀 MagicOS 状态栏右侧的 Wi-Fi、移动信号、电池 合并为一个仿 iPhone「Duo」风格的三合一字形模块。 全层（宿主层 Hook、图形渲染引擎、状态采样与设置界面）统一采用 Kotlin 实现，应用包名 io.github.odomu.honorduo。 核心特性 三合一字形：支持圆环与胶囊双形态，宽度申报即时响应，邻近图标自动平滑让位。 智能防烧屏：专为 OLED 屏幕设计的 30 秒 3×3 离散网格微米级平移机制，结合边界安全钳制，保护屏幕且功耗极低...

releases.name: HonorDuo 1.0.6
releases.descriptionHTML:
1.0.6

功能添加

  • 隐藏隐私指示：功能设置 → 基础外观，新增开关（默认关闭）。状态栏右侧那个绿色圆点表示有应用正在使用相机或麦克风，开启后不再显示；关闭它等于关掉系统唯一的这项提醒，请按需开启。

功能修复

  • 胶囊样式左右两侧留白：组件外观 → 摆放，左右两侧的 Wi-Fi 位只在实际连上 Wi-Fi 时占位；关闭 Wi-Fi 或未连接时不再空出一道，字形重新居中。
  • 胶囊下方副卡信号点：胶囊下沿放置 SIM 1 / SIM 2 后，每张卡按自己的信号强度点亮，不再固定显示为未激活。
  • 预览与真机一致：设置页预览与状态栏用同一份 Wi-Fi 状态计算占位，预览里看到的宽度就是状态栏里的宽度。
  • 状态栏时钟不再消失：打开设置页的同时下拉通知栏，时间偶尔会一直不回来；现在行重新布局后会自动恢复。
  • 横屏下拉后时钟异常：横屏时下拉通知栏，时间会缩成看不见的一点；状态栏高度未测出的那一帧不再把字号压成 0。
  • 字形与环外读数不再丢失：状态栏重新布局后，三合一字形、信号读数、性能读数与制式标签会自己补回原位。
  • 恢复配置立即生效：恢复备份后，农历开关、日期/星期格式、上下行偏移、行距、间距与颜色会一并同步到状态栏，不再需要再改一次设置才显示。
  • 减少状态栏重复布局：状态栏布局同步只在尺寸、顺序或内容实际变化时更新，避免下拉和高频刷新时重复测量。

安装：覆盖安装即可，设置全部保留。

releases.name: HonorDuo 1.0.5
releases.descriptionHTML:
1.0.5

新增功能

  • 支持左右两侧组件：左右两侧可放置信号点与 Wi-Fi 弧形，信号点与上下缺口使用同一套柱数与点大小设置。
  • 支持显示信号强度：支持在状态栏实时显示当前提供移动数据的上网卡信号强度；开启路径在「功能设置 → 性能读数 → 信号强度」。
  • 支持设置生效范围：「基础外观」中提供多选生效范围菜单，排除范围的将自动恢复出厂原生电池与网络图标。
  • 支持显示蓝牙电量：支持将已连接蓝牙耳机的剩余电量单独显示和三合一显示。
  • 支持隐藏HD图标：在「下拉面板」中提供独立开关，支持按需隐藏状态栏及下拉面板中的「HD / VoLTE」高清通话图标以及「VoWiFi」图标。
  • 支持隐藏系统通知：在「下拉面板」中提供独立开关，支持按需隐藏「极速充电/USB充电」、「热点共享」与「USB 调试」的常驻系统通知。
  • 支持天气交互：支持在通知中心日期行实时显示天气与温度，点击日期区域可直接快捷打开系统天气应用。

安装：覆盖安装即可，设置全部保留。

releases.name: HonorDuo 1.0.4
releases.descriptionHTML:
1.0.4

新增功能

  • 新增电池电压读数：支持在状态栏实时显示电池当前电压（如 3.85V）；开启路径在「功能设置 → 性能读数 → 电池电压」，与功率、温度、电流、帧率无缝协同参与顺序自适应堆叠。
  • 读数刷新频率全覆盖：读数刷新频率（默认 10s，可调 1–120s）现在同时统一接管充电功率、电池温度、电池电流与电池电压的回读周期，进一步优化日常待机续航。

问题修复

  • 读数自适应堆叠与独立显示：修复开启多项读数时挤压为三行导致文字过小的缺陷；现在单组严格限制最多双行堆叠，多于两项时自适应拆分并建立第二组读数，根据开启顺序智能两两成对或独立大字号显示。
  • 状态栏原生时钟重叠：修复在特定场景下原生系统时间与模块时间同时出现在左上角或时间重叠的缺陷，强化状态栏时钟冲突抑制；优化「隐藏状态栏时钟」开关文案。
  • 电池电流与功率显示优化：修复在部分机型上电池电流显示为 0mA 或单位异常的问题，优化电流与功率的动态刷新联动，默认以安培（A）单位更直观呈现。
  • 模块总开关完备覆盖：修复关闭模块总开关后通知中心隐藏按钮、天气与图标替换未即时归零还原的问题；关闭总开关时所有增强功能即刻无缝交还系统。
  • 通知中心与天气即时还原：关闭通知中心隐藏按钮或关闭天气时，界面即刻响应恢复原生样式，无需等待下一分钟或重启系统界面。
  • 状态栏时钟即时卸载：优化自定义时钟卸载链路，关闭时钟天气或关闭模块时主线程即刻移除自定义视图并恢复原生时钟，解决关闭天气后时钟残留与延迟问题。
  • 首页已开启项统计修复：修复未开启「三合一图标合并」时首页已开启组件统计显示为 0 的问题，精准统计当前处于生效状态的全部功能数。
  • 胶囊帧率放置修复：修复将帧率添加至胶囊布局后无法正常绘制的问题。
  • Wi-Fi 弧开孔自适应缩放：修复胶囊和圆环开口处 Wi-Fi 弧外圈与底部被边缘截断的问题，自适应保留安全边距。
  • 滑块拖动调参防抖：修复滑动调节尺寸等参数时状态栏读数跟随高频重新读取、剧烈跳动的缺陷，彻底消除滑动调参时的读数异常闪烁。

体验与性能优化

  • 息屏与后台待机零开销：在息屏待机、全屏游戏或视频时，后台时钟定时器、帧动画调度与未开启的天气查询自动进入完全休眠，消除不必要的后台耗电。
  • 底层运行能效提升：重构底层反射与系统资源访问机制，建立高速无锁并发缓存，消除高频界面重绘与测量过程中的运算损耗，大幅降低状态栏高刷运行负载。

安装：覆盖安装即可，设置全部保留。

FuckCainiao 0.2.6

安装迁移

功能

  • 首页保留取包裹、寄包裹、出库码；底部保留首页与我的。
  • 过滤开屏、首页推广、推荐商品、物流广告和奖励浮层。
  • 精简新版「我的」热门活动与图片横幅。
  • 清除首页搜索框滚动文案，隐藏搜索页月度包裹视频和今日好物推荐。

modules.name: io.github.kelebao.colorosclockseconds
modules.description: 状态栏时钟显秒 + 点击切换（LSPosed 模块）。Status bar clock seconds with tap-to-toggle (LSPosed module)
modules.summary: 让状态栏（左上角）时钟显示秒，并支持单击（或长按）时钟随时切换显秒开关，同时把小时十位数标红。界面完整适配简体中文、English 等 21 种语言，自动跟随系统语言。不依赖任何厂商私有类，已在 ColorOS 15 真机验证，同时兼容小米、一加、荣耀、vivo 等主流厂商，最低支持 Android 10。模块仅作用域系统界面（SystemUI），关闭显秒后立即停止每秒刷新定时器，更省电。

releases.name: v1.2.0
releases.descriptionHTML:
v1.2.0（versionCode 249）— 时分秒逐位取色、整串渐变、自定义任务

新增功能

  • 6 位数字独立取色：时十位 / 时个位 / 分十位 / 分个位 / 秒十位 / 秒个位各一个颜色。10 颗预设色点、色相·饱和度·明度三条滑杆、调色盘，也能跟随系统文字色。
  • 点预览时间展开取色：数字放大、字距拉开，直接点某一位即选中该位；选中位有同色下划线与 2 秒一循环的发光呼吸，其余 5 位降到 30% 不透明度。
  • 整串渐变：起点色 → 终点色平滑过渡，6 套渐变预设 + 两端自定义；数字颜色卡分「逐位颜色 ｜ 渐变」两页，停在哪页就是哪种模式（页签即开关）。
  • 自定义任务：每小时 / 每天指定时刻，可提前 N 分钟开始、持续 N 分钟，到点自动显示或隐藏秒数；改系统时间、切时区、休眠唤醒后自动重算窗口，另有每 60 秒兜底重算。
  • 悬浮时间（长按状态栏时钟）：与状态栏相同的渐变配色，改色 1 秒内跟随；等宽数字，秒数跳动时色带不再「游走」。
  • 页面标题「时间显秒」改为粉尘点阵：进入时由散点聚拢成字，点一下炸开再聚回。

修复

  • ColorOS 上显秒后颜色被系统「洗」回去：写入文本末尾补零宽空格，破坏系统的 HH:mm(:ss) 模式匹配，颜色得以保留。
  • 「关了秒再打开，秒数不动」：补上接管分支缺失的刷新计时器。
  • 部分机型单击状态栏无反应：修正触摸目标指向。
  • 预览渐变与状态栏渐变有色差（仅个别亮色）：两边统一到同一套配色函数，并放宽对亮色的过度压暗。
  • 个别分辨率下预览数字下半被裁：按实测字形高度反推字号上限，并加运行时兜底。
  • ColorOS 15 上预览渐变一个数字一个纯色：预览卡改为自绘渐变（系统绘制路径会对 shader 按字形量化）。
  • 单色模式预览冒号偏下：补冒号光学居中（上移 0.11em）。
  • 打开自定义任务界面时状态栏消失：修正弹窗窗口标志。
  • 空闲时持续空转耗电：自适应节流，判定真正掉色才加速，连续无异常自动停表。

优化与移除

  • 移除「流动」功能（含开关与速度滑杆）：只保留静态渐变，系统界面 CPU 回到基线（约 7%，流动时最高约 40%）。
  • 移除「省电自适应」：省电模式下不再暂停走秒，仅熄屏 / 非交互时降频。
  • 移除独立的「小时颜色」卡与独立的「启用渐变」开关，能力并入「数字颜色」两页签。
  • 设置页顶部空白带、任务编辑页「动作」行、卡片按压与音效等细节一并打磨。

说明

  • 最低支持 Android 10 及以上。
  • 已在 ColorOS 15 / 16（Android 15 / 16）真机验证；核心链路只用 AOSP 公开 API，其它厂商理论上同样生效，但尚未逐一真机实测。
  • 安装后需重启系统界面（设置页内有「重启 SystemUI」按钮），或执行 adb shell su -c 'killall com.android.systemui'。
  • 有问题或建议，欢迎到 GitHub 提 Issue。

v1.2.0 (versionCode 249) — per-digit colors, gradients, scheduled tasks

New

  • Independent color for each of the 6 digits (tens/ones of hour, minute and second): 10 preset swatches, hue/saturation/brightness sliders, color picker, or follow the system text color.
  • Tap the preview time to edit colors: digits enlarge and get spaced out; tap a digit to select it. The selected digit gets a matching underline plus a 2-second glow-breathing loop, the other five drop to 30% opacity.
  • Full-string gradient: start color → end color, 6 presets plus custom endpoints. The color card has two tabs, Per-digit | Gradient; whichever tab is active is the active mode (the tab is the switch).
  • Scheduled tasks: hourly or daily at a given time, start N minutes early, run N minutes, and turn seconds on or off automatically. Windows are recomputed after time/timezone changes and on wake, with a 60-second fallback.
  • Floating time (long-press the status bar clock): same gradient as the status bar, following color changes within a second; tabular digits keep the band steady while seconds tick.
  • The page title is now a dust-particle effect: specks gather into the text on entry and scatter when tapped.

Fixes

  • Colors being stripped by the system once seconds are shown (zero-width space appended to defeat the HH:mm(:ss) pattern match).
  • Seconds frozen after turning them off and on again (missing refresh timer in the takeover branch).
  • Single tap on the status bar doing nothing on some devices (touch target).
  • Preview vs. status bar gradient mismatch on a few bright colors (one shared color-adaptation function).
  • The lower half of preview digits being clipped at some resolutions (measured ink height plus a runtime fallback).
  • Preview gradient quantized to one solid color per digit on ColorOS 15 (the preview now draws the gradient itself).
  • Colon sitting too low in per-digit mode (optical centering, 0.11em lift).
  • Status bar disappearing while the task editor was open (window flags).
  • Idle battery drain (adaptive throttling; the ticker stops when nothing is wrong).

Changed / removed

  • Removed the animated "flow" feature: static gradient only; SystemUI CPU back to baseline (~7% of one core vs. up to ~40% while flowing).
  • Removed the power-save adaptation: seconds keep ticking in power-save mode; only screen-off/non-interactive throttles.
  • The standalone hour-color card and the standalone gradient switch were folded into the two tabs.

Notes

  • Requires Android 10 or newer.
  • Verified on real devices running ColorOS 15 / 16 (Android 15 / 16). The core path only uses public AOSP APIs, so other vendors should work in theory but have not been verified one by one.
  • Restart SystemUI after installing (there is a button in the settings page), or run adb shell su -c 'killall com.android.systemui'.
  • Issues and suggestions: please open a GitHub issue.

releases.name: v1.0.9
releases.descriptionHTML:
v1.0.9（versionCode 10）— 设置页视觉与体验优化

新增功能

  • 预览卡秒刻度盘：预览卡新增一圈刻度盘，颜色采用深绿、深青、深海军蓝、深金等沉稳配色，随时间缓缓流动变化；深色模式下自动切换为更亮的配色，依然清晰可见。

优化

  • 小时颜色色块光晕更亮：色块呼吸时，最亮的一下比之前更亮、更明显。
  • 关闭小时颜色时装饰弧不再消失：右下角三条装饰弧现在始终显示；关闭小时颜色时色块只是变淡，不再有弧线透上来、像是盖在色块上的情况。
  • 读屏（TalkBack）更好用：开启手机读屏后，小时颜色的每个色块会念出颜色名称和色号（例如「红色 #F44336」），选中哪个也会播报；设置页里的按钮也都能被正确识别为可点击。
  • 更省电、更流畅：设置页滚动到预览卡不可见时，自动停止它的动画刷新以省电；同时修复了深色模式下刻度盘有一段颜色几乎看不见的问题。

说明

  • 最低支持 Android 10 及以上。
  • 主要在 ColorOS（一加）上做过真机验证；其他品牌手机走的是通用适配，逻辑上兼容，但没有逐一实测。
  • 有问题或建议，欢迎到 GitHub 提 Issue。

v1.0.9 (versionCode 10) — Settings UI & Experience Polish

New Features

  • Second-tick dial on the preview card: The preview card now shows a ring of tick marks in calm colors (deep green, deep teal, deep navy, deep gold) that slowly shift over time. In dark mode it switches to a brighter palette so it stays clearly visible.

Improvements

  • Brighter glow on hour-color swatches: The breathing glow on the color swatches now peaks brighter and more noticeable.
  • Decorative arcs stay when hour color is off: The three decorative arcs in the corner now always stay visible. When hour color is turned off, the swatches just dim — no more arcs showing through them.
  • Better screen-reader support: With a screen reader, each hour-color swatch now announces its name and hex code (e.g. "红色 #F44336"), and the selected one is announced too. Buttons on the settings page are now properly exposed as actionable.
  • More power-efficient and smoother: The preview animation auto-pauses when scrolled off-screen, saving battery. Also fixed a dark-mode issue where part of the dial was nearly invisible.

Notes

  • Requires Android 10 or later.
  • Primarily verified on ColorOS (OnePlus); other brands use generic adaptation and should work, but aren't individually tested.
  • Issues and suggestions are welcome on GitHub.

Full Changelog: https://assets.lsposed.org/raw/kelebao/ClockSeconds/main/CHANGELOG.md?sign=3c9d0dcdb69003f532a5b5cd6b61bd97&t=6a03bf00

releases.name: v1.0.8
releases.descriptionHTML:
v1.0.8 (versionCode 9)

安全加固：配置接收器改用 signature 级自定义权限，阻止任意应用广播代写 Settings.Secure/Global。

modules.name: io.github.mrxsin.youtubehideads
modules.summary: Removes YouTube ads, sponsored Shorts and promotions, skips SponsorBlock segments, and adds fullscreen brightness/volume swipes and original-audio selection.

releases.descriptionHTML:
What's new since 1.1.0

  • Works with YouTube 21.43.523. Background playback and SponsorBlock skipping had stopped working
    after the YouTube update; both are back. (#3)
  • Update check. Once each time YouTube starts, the module asks GitHub whether a newer release
    exists and, if so, shows a YouTube-style dialog with Update (opens the release page) and
    Later. It is on by default; turn it off under About → Check for updates.
  • Report a problem. About → Compatibility & diagnostics → Report a problem opens a new GitHub
    issue with the compatibility report already filled in. Nothing is sent until you submit it.
  • New name: YouTube Hide Ads, matching the other modules. Settings, package and saved preferences
    are unchanged.
  • The About page and compatibility report show the real version again (1.1.0 showed 1.1.0 (132)).
  • SponsorBlock request failures are now logged with their cause.

Known issue: HTTPS filtering apps

AdGuard and similar apps, when their certificate is installed as a system certificate, stop
SponsorBlock and the update check from connecting (NOT_ENOUGH_SCTS in the log). Exclude
sponsor.ajay.app and github.com from HTTPS filtering. Details.

Verified

Pixel 8 Pro, Android 17, Vector 2.2 (libxposed API 102), YouTube 21.43.523: every startup self-check
passes and every hook installs; background playback continued after Home and with the screen off for a
video opened from a link; original audio was selected on a multi-language video; the update dialog and
both buttons, the switch and the prefilled issue were checked. Device checks and limits.

Other YouTube versions, devices and 32-bit/x86 ABIs are not certified. The APK is arm64-v8a only.

Version metadata

  • Version name: 1.2.0
  • Android version code: 155
  • Package: io.github.mrxsin.youtubehideads
  • Git tag: v1.2.0
  • APK filename: YouTubeHideAds-v1.2.0.apk
  • APK SHA-256: d984de2fda0ca0e29d1b98823142915f6a54403f9d12a86f687c7950661e6d0d

Installing

Install the APK over 1.1.0; settings are kept in YouTube's data. Keep com.google.android.youtube as
the only scope in Vector or LSPosed, then force-stop and reopen YouTube.

What's new since 1.0.0

  • Background playback, including Made for Kids videos and videos opened from a link. It has its
    own switch under Player and does not depend on Hide ads or SponsorBlock. Restart YouTube after
    changing it.
  • A YouTubeHideAds section above Account in YouTube Settings, YouTube-style module pages and a
    Compatibility & diagnostics page with a copyable report.
  • SponsorBlock: a player icon beside autoplay with a floating menu like YouTube's own, ten category
    modes and colors with a visual picker, manual skip/undo, segment preview, submission and voting,
    channel exclusions, statistics, settings transfer, bounded retry and a cross-video cache.
  • Shorts: hide ten individual buttons and panels, and skip live Shorts. Both are off by default.
  • Swipe controls shown as a pill with YouTube's brightness or volume icon, a level and the value.
  • Nine more languages, following YouTube's language: 简体中文, 繁體中文, Español, Português,
    Русский, 日本語, 한국어, Bahasa Indonesia and Bahasa Melayu.
  • Lighter and faster. The Brainfuck bridge used to reopen the module APK on every policy call,
    which was about 23 % of YouTube's CPU while scrolling and playing; it is now under 0.1 %. DexKit
    results are cached per YouTube build, so after the first launch YouTube shows its first screen about
    0.35 s sooner.

Verified

Pixel 8 Pro, Android 17, Vector 2.2 (libxposed API 102), YouTube 21.42.243: all 11 startup self-check
suites pass and every hook installs, with or without the DexKit cache. Ads and sponsored Shorts were
removed, SponsorBlock lookups and original audio worked, and background playback continued from the
feed and from a link (Home and screen off) and stopped when its switch was off.
Device checks and limits.

Other YouTube versions, devices and 32-bit/x86 ABIs are not certified. The APK is arm64-v8a only.

Version metadata

  • Version name: 1.1.0
  • Android version code: 153
  • Package: io.github.mrxsin.youtubehideads
  • Git tag: v1.1.0
  • APK filename: YouTubeHideAds-v1.1.0.apk
  • APK SHA-256: 80029979ada6a92fe1805994f9abe45cc4a4a898027a971adc2e8d297ac66060

Installing

Install the APK over 1.0.0; settings are kept in YouTube's data. Keep com.google.android.youtube as
the only scope in Vector or LSPosed, then force-stop and reopen YouTube.

YouTube Hide Ads v1.0.0

First public release

Removes YouTube ads and unwanted feed content, skips SponsorBlock segments, and adds fullscreen brightness/volume swipes and original-audio selection. Policy decisions are compiled Brainfuck; the host is a single XAX semantic store.

Features

  • Video, feed/search and shopping ads; sponsored Shorts removed before the pager is built.
  • Premium, fullscreen and engagement-panel promotions.
  • SponsorBlock: privacy-preserving hash-prefix lookup, guarded seeks; sponsor and self-promotion on by default.
  • Playables, preview videos, Explore more topics and posts hidden by default; feed Shorts optional.
  • Optional AI-channel filters (high and medium confidence AiSList lists).
  • Fullscreen swipes: left edge brightness, right edge media volume.
  • Prefers the original audio track on multi-language videos.
  • Settings under YouTube → You → Settings → YoutubeHideAds.

Changed since the last development build

  • New package io.github.mrxsin.youtubehideads (was org.youtubehideads.module).
  • Seven identical gate libraries merged into one liband3.so. The APK has 11 native libraries instead of 17 and is about 97 KB smaller. Behavior is unchanged.

Verified

  • Pixel 8 Pro, Android 17, YouTube 21.41.525, Vector 2.2 (libxposed API 102): all 531 startup self-checks pass and every hook installs. The installed APK matches the published SHA-256.
  • Per-feature off/on UI checks were last run on development build 77 with the same policy bytes.

Other YouTube versions, devices and 32-bit/x86 ABIs are not certified. The APK is arm64-v8a only.

Version metadata

  • Version name: 1.0.0
  • Android version code: 100
  • Package: io.github.mrxsin.youtubehideads
  • Git tag: v1.0.0
  • APK filename: YouTubeHideAds-v1.0.0.apk
  • APK SHA-256: 0c57a68a23baafc5a8b619bee3057ef7785c7d866853ebd45c4c81baa69ceb2b

Installing

Install the APK, enable YoutubeHideAds in Vector or LSPosed with com.google.android.youtube as the only scope, then force-stop and reopen YouTube. If a development build (org.youtubehideads.module) is installed, uninstall it first. Your settings are kept in YouTube's data.

A lightweight, headless LSPosed module that restores carrier-provided CNAP caller names in Xiaomi's MIUI/HyperOS dialer.

Included

  • CNAP name on the incoming-call screen
  • CNAP name in call notifications
  • CNAP name in Xiaomi Dialer Recents
  • CNAP name on the "Unknown contact" detail page
  • Phone number shown beneath the name in Recents
  • Saved contacts and Xiaomi caller-identification results take priority
  • Incoming, missed, and rejected call support
  • No changes to outgoing calls
  • No background service, timer, worker thread, receiver, or network access

Required scope

  • System Framework
  • com.android.incallui
  • com.android.contacts

Reboot after enabling the module because System Framework is included in the scope.

Compatibility

CNAP availability depends on the carrier. Existing call-history entries are not renamed.

本次变更

  • 使用独立包名及独立正式签名；后续保持同一应用 ID 和签名进行覆盖升级。
  • 显式指定 Yuki 模块身份，隔离新旧模块广播、设置 Provider、通知图片和页面入口。
  • 保留 HyperOS 4 耳机控制、左右耳与在线耳机仓电量、超级岛、诊断和 Miuix 设置界面。

此包不能覆盖旧 moe.chenxy.hyperpods。请先在 LSPosed 关闭旧模块，再安装、启用 HyperPods HyperOS 4，勾选 com.android.bluetooth、com.xiaomi.bluetooth、com.android.systemui，打开新应用重新配置选项并重启手机。不要同时启用新旧两个模块。之后独立包可正常覆盖升级。

350 项单元测试、8 项 Android 包身份与设置存储测试通过，Lint 无错误；原生边界检查、16KB ZIP 对齐、新正式签名匹配和 Release 安装启动检查通过。用户已确认本次测试包工作正常；不同手机、耳机型号和固件仍以实际兼容情况为准。

下载附件 APK，无需解压。文件名末尾为 MD5 前 8 位。

  • Version: 1.191
  • VersionCode: 191
  • Commit: a1d3c7a
  • Build time: 7m 24s
  • SHA256: fe7851878c3d98524dbab9453db2a53d65f15c88f9ca572de0030f9d7af662b4

Message

fix(fusehide): Harden FUSE invalidation and hot reload, Meow

之前有些目录明明该隐藏，却会因为别的 UID 先访问过，就从 FUSE 缓存里漏出来喵（伸爪按住乱跑的 dentry）。这次把 lookup 和 READDIRPLUS 的缓存一起管好，不让不同 UID 再串缓存喵。

顺手理了理 Session 生命周期和失效队列，让通知跟着正确的 Session 代次走喵。热更新碰到 root_ino=0 时，会先查看 AOSP 和设备实际 libfuse_jni 的节点树喵（认真翻翻节点树）。只有确认这个 Session 没创建对应子节点、也没有缓存要清，才跳过没必要的根目录通知喵；有东西要清的还是照常处理喵。

另外补好了 KernelSU 热安装、模块操作和配置重载的细节喵。根 inode 和回调入口的诊断日志继续留着，但只在全局 Debug 开关打开时才打印，Release 就安静一点喵（把日志本收好）。测试源码也从 app/src/main 移走，不放进正式项目喵。

releases.name: HyperLux 4.3.3
releases.descriptionHTML:
HyperLux 4.3.3

  1. 新增控制中心节点控制：亮度条可按设备真实节点调节，支持完整控制、分区增强和自定义增强上限。
  2. 新增深色模式独立亮度曲线，可分别调整深浅色模式的亮度。
  3. 完善部分平板亮度曲线与控制中心映射兼容。
  4. 修复部分设备熄屏前亮度反复变亮、变暗的问题。
  5. 新增“恢复系统默认”，方便撤销亮度定制。
  6. 优化控制中心操作示意、二级页面沉浸及关于页按钮对齐。
  7. 深浅色模式新增手动记忆处理选择，可清除、共用或各自独立学习。
  8. 手动记忆按当前主题展示，支持分别保存为基础曲线和清除记忆。
  9. 基础曲线最右端节点支持向下调整，深色模式同样适用。
  10. 改善节点调节时的亮度显示，修复部分设备状态页一直显示 0 的问题。
  11. 修复分区节点控制二次上滑可能卡在普通亮度区间顶部的问题。
  12. 改善控制中心节点控制的稳定性，修复退出增强区间后可能再次失效的问题。
  13. 控制中心映射新增系统界面作用域检查、添加提示及“重启系统界面”按钮。
  14. 完善分析包记录，保留节点控制程序上次运行日志，便于排查间歇性问题。

主屏手动亮度页面：

  1. 作用域无法确认时，直接弹窗提醒添加“系统界面”。
  2. 节点保持不再因 HDR 退出，保留系统图像处理。
  3. 磁贴新增独立最高节点设置。
  4. 页面顶部新增红底烧屏、极端亮度偏色提示。

4.3.0 详细更新（保留大版本内容）

以下为4.3.0发布时的记录；4.3.1对主题记忆、最高点编辑及亮度显示的改进见末尾追加部分。

相较上一公开正式版 4.2.0 / 42000（release-4.2.0），累计合入 Beta 01—09 的最终功能和修复，以下按当前实际行为整理。

控制中心完整节点控制

  • 在“主屏手动亮度”页面提供独立的控制中心映射设置，可选择关闭、完整节点控制或分区节点控制，默认关闭；旧版隐藏比例映射及已保存选择保留，不在覆盖更新时自动改成节点写入。
  • 完整模式下，滑条按当前主屏真实背光节点比例显示，拉满对应设备读取到的 max_brightness。不同设备使用自己的上限，不写死16383、4095或其他节点值。
  • 手动拖动后关闭自动亮度、放开暗光锁定并保持节点，不参与手动记忆；重新打开自动亮度结束保持。锁屏暂停、解锁恢复，物理屏或控制权变化按原处理。
  • 与主屏亮度面板共用原生保持程序、租约和异常恢复，不另建一套节点写入服务；只在明确启用且接口、节点权限及监听连接均可用时接入。Root暂缺只影响对应路径，不重置其他设置。

分区节点控制与操作示意

  • 滑条下方75%为普通区间，上方25%为增强区间。普通上限读取原机HBM过渡点，或经验证的普通亮度上限，再按本机标定换算；75%只是显示比例，不是硬件节点比例。
  • 普通区间沿用系统调节，自动亮度开启时继续参与手动记忆。首次向上拖到普通上限时，当前滑块同步停在边界；松手后3秒内快速再次上滑，才进入增强区。
  • 增强区按普通节点上界至用户设置的最高节点均匀分配。最高节点默认使用设备真实上限，也可通过滑条或数值输入调整；此值只约束手动增强目标，不限制系统自动阳光屏。
